text: dsh-free-web-search 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的网页搜索插件：它注册搜索提供器，并提供搜索、平台检索、网页读取和引擎诊断工具。搜索可在 Bing、DuckDuckGo、SearXNG 等引擎间自动回退，也支持时间范围和指定引擎；平台检索覆盖 GitHub 与 Reddit，网页读取会提取页面文本。可在设置页配置引擎，部分引擎可配置 API 密钥；基础搜索引擎无需额外密钥。适合需要在 DSH 对话中搜索网页资料、查找代码仓库或阅读网页的用户。

dsh-free-web-search adds web search to DSH's web client. It provides multi-engine search with automatic fallback, time filters, GitHub and Reddit search, and single-page text extraction. Engine selection lives in settings; some engines accept API keys, while basic search needs none.
想让 DSH 在对话里搜索网页并给出来源链接。
能不能按最近一周筛选网页搜索结果？
我想指定搜索引擎查一个问题，失败时还能自动换引擎。
帮我找 GitHub 仓库或 Reddit 讨论，不要只搜普通网页。
我有一个网址，想让 DSH 读出网页正文。
搜索服务偶尔不可用时，有没有能自动尝试其他来源的办法？
I want web search results with links directly in my DSH conversation.
Can I search GitHub or Reddit from the assistant and get source snippets?
dsh-free-web-search 的功能「多引擎网页搜索」：通过 DSH 搜索提供器查询网页，首选引擎失败或无结果时继续尝试其他引擎，并返回来源链接与摘要。
dsh-free-web-search 的功能「时间范围搜索」：调用 advanced_search 并提供相对时间或日期，可按时间范围搜索；还可指定优先尝试的引擎，结果以来源列表返回。
dsh-free-web-search 的功能「平台检索」：使用 platform_search 指定 GitHub 或 Reddit 与查询词，返回匹配条目的链接、标题和摘要。
dsh-free-web-search 的功能「读取网页」：调用 web_fetch 提供网址，插件获取单页内容并清理 HTML 标记，返回纯文本；内容过长时按字符上限截断。

dsh-free-web-search README · dsh-free-web-search：Free web search plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). No API keys required — works out of the box with Bing, DuckDuckGo, and SearXNG. Optional paid engines (Exa, Tavily, Keenable, Perplexity, DeepSeek Official) activate when you add a key.

dsh-free-web-search README · Features：- **10 search engines** with automatic fallback — if one fails, the next one picks up
- **Time-filtered search** via `advanced_search` tool (last day/week/month/year, or custom ranges like `3d`, `2mo`, `2026-07-01`)
- **Platform search** — GitHub repos and Reddit threads via `platform_search` tool
- **Engine diagnostics** — `free_search_test` tool to check which engines work
- **Web Settings UI** — engine selection, API key management, cache TTL config
- **Result caching** — LRU cache (50 entries, configurable TTL up to 5 min) to reduce rate limiting

dsh-free-web-search README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:delef/dsh-free-web-search
```

If pnpm blocks the build script, add the key it prints to `allowBuilds` in your profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` and retry.

dsh-free-web-search README · Engines：| Engine | Cost | Key required |
|--------|------|-------------|
| Bing | Free | No |
| DuckDuckGo (HTML / Lite) | Free | No |
| SearXNG | Free | No |
| AnySearch AI | Free | No |
| Exa | Free tier / paid | Optional |
| Tavily | Free tier / paid | Optional |
| Keenable | Free tier / paid | Optional |
| Perplexity | Paid | Yes |
| DeepSeek Official | Paid | Yes |

Default engine: **Bing** (most stable). Change it in Settings > Plugins > Free Web Search, or type `/free-search-engine` in chat.
dsh-free-web-search README · `web_search` (built-in, powered by this plugin)：Standard harness web search. Uses the configured engine with automatic fallback.

dsh-free-web-search README · `advanced_search`：```
query: "rust async runtime"
timeRange: "week"        # day | week | month | year | 3d | 2mo | 1y | 2026-07-01
engine: "exa"            # optional, override preferred engine
maxResults: 5

dsh-free-web-search README · `platform_search`：```
platform: "github"       # github | reddit
query: "deepseek harness plugins"
maxResults: 5
```

dsh-free-web-search README · `web_fetch`：```
url: "https://docs.example.com/guide"
maxLength: 50000                       # optional, default 50000 chars
```

Fetches a single page, strips HTML, returns plain text. For reading articles, docs, or any URL.
dsh-free-web-search README · `free_search_test`：Tests engine availability. No arguments tests all engines.

dsh-free-web-search README · Configuration：Settings are managed through the web UI (Settings > Plugins > Free Web Search) or in the `free-web-search` entry of the active profile (DSH 0.2+; earlier releases used the `free-search` section of `settings.yaml`):

```yaml
- id: free-web-search
  name: dsh-free-web-search
  config:
    provider: bing

dsh-free-web-search README · Configuration：Profiles that still use the old entry id `web-search-free` keep working, but the plugin logs a deprecation warning and the settings card shows a notice. Rename the entry to `free-web-search` to migrate.

Requires DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.2` (developed against `0.2.1-rc.5`).
